basic_details.short_information: The Recruitment Rules Cell of the Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (Personnel Wing), Government of Puducherry, proposes to engage one retired Government officer who served in the cadre of Superintendent / Junior Accounts Officer as a Consultant on a full-time contractual basis, initially for six months. Applications in the Annexure-I format must be sent in a sealed cover to the Under Secretary to Government (Personnel) so as to reach the Department on or before 03.12.2026.

qualification.details: One Consultant is required, engaged in the Recruitment Rules Cell on a full-time contractual basis, initially for a period of six months. | Eligibility: the applicant shall be a retired Government official who had served in the cadre of Superintendent / Junior Accounts Officer in the Government of Puducherry. Age: the maximum age limit for engagement shall be 65 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Experience: the applicant shall possess adequate knowledge and experience in framing and amendment of Recruitment Rules and establishment-related matters. Preference: retired Government officers having experience in personnel-related matters shall be given preference. Pay: the notice prints no amount. Remuneration and other terms and conditions of engagement are governed by O.M. No. 46324/FD/F3/2026, dated 27.08.2026, issued by the Finance Department, Puducherry. | The notice does not specify any educational qualification beyond the service condition above.

important_instructions: The Recruitment Rules Cell works under the Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (Personnel Wing), Chief Secretariat, Government of Puducherry. The Consultant will handle work relating to the review, amendment and framing of Recruitment Rules received from Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Boards and Societies under the Government of Puducherry.

The selection procedure, remuneration and other terms of engagement are governed by Finance Department O.M. No. 46324/FD/F3/2026, dated 27.08.2026. The selected Consultant must execute an Agreement in the prescribed format at the time of engagement. The engagement is purely temporary and non-official in nature for the specific assignment. The engagement is liable to be terminated by the undersigned at any time, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment Rules Cell
content_sections.text: The Recruitment Rules Cell works under the Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (Personnel Wing), Chief Secretariat, Government of Puducherry. The Consultant will handle work relating to the review, amendment and framing of Recruitment Rules received from Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Boards and Societies under the Government of Puducherry.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to: Under Secretary to Government (Personnel), Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (Personnel Wing), Puducherry. The notice prints no PIN code for this address. Use the prescribed format appended to the notice as Annexure-I (Proforma), duly filled in. Enclose the requisite enclosures with the application. Place the application in a sealed cover superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CONSULTANT". The application must reach the Department on or before 03.12.2026. The notice does not name a postal mode.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: One Consultant is required, engaged in the Recruitment Rules Cell on a full-time contractual basis, initially for a period of six months. Eligibility: the applicant shall be a retired Government official who had served in the cadre of Superintendent / Junior Accounts Officer in the Government of Puducherry. Age: the maximum age limit for engagement shall be 65 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Experience: the applicant shall possess adequate knowledge and experience in framing and amendment of Recruitment Rules and establishment-related matters. Preference: retired Government officers having experience in personnel-related matters shall be given preference. Pay: the notice prints no amount. Remuneration and other terms and conditions of engagement are governed by O.M. No. 46324/FD/F3/2026, dated 27.08.2026, issued by the Finance Department, Puducherry. The notice does not specify any educational qualification beyond the service condition above.

content_sections.heading: DPAR Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: Framing and amendment of Recruitment Rules for Group 'A', 'B' and 'C' posts in coordination with the concerned Government Departments. Scrutiny and review of proposals relating to the framing and amendment of Recruitment Rules received from various Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Boards and Societies under the Government of Puducherry.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled-in application in the Annexure-I format. Copy of the PPO (the form asks for it against "Last Pay drawn"). One recent passport size photo, pasted on the form. Other requisite enclosures, as the notice says, without listing them further. Annexure-I asks for: name, date of birth, address for communication, contact number, e-mail id, date of joining Government service, date of retirement and post held at retirement, name of the Department / Organization from which retired, last pay drawn, educational qualification, details of knowledge in computer, a table of experience (Ministry / Department, period from and to, post held, nature of work, starting from the last appointment) and any additional information supporting suitability. It ends with a declaration that the particulars are true and correct and that the applicant was clear from the vigilance angle at the time of retirement.

faq.question: Q1. How many Consultant posts are there in DPAR Puducherry?
faq.answer: The notice requires one person (01) for the post of Consultant in the Recruitment Rules Cell.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DPAR Consultant post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Department on or before 03.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the DPAR Consultant post?
faq.answer: Only a retired Government official who had served in the cadre of Superintendent / Junior Accounts Officer in the Government of Puducherry can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DPAR Consultant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for engagement is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is needed for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience in framing and amendment of Recruitment Rules and establishment-related matters. Retired officers with experience in personnel-related matters are given preference.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DPAR Consultant post?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-I proforma, add the requisite enclosures and send it in a sealed cover superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CONSULTANT" to the Under Secretary to Government (Personnel), DPAR (Personnel Wing), Puducherry.

faq.question: Q7. Is the DPAR Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a full-time contractual engagement, initially for six months, and is purely temporary and non-official in nature for the specific assignment.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired employees apply, and how is their pay fixed?
faq.answer: Yes, the engagement is open to retired Government officers who served as Superintendent / Junior Accounts Officer. Remuneration is governed by Finance Department O.M. No. 46324/FD/F3/2026, dated 27.08.2026.

faq.question: Q9. Can the engagement be ended early?
faq.answer: Yes. The engagement is liable to be terminated by the undersigned at any time, without assigning any reason.
